description.value:
Compatibility: Avian

Yarhuda feathers, even their flight feathers, vary genetically in length. Long-cloaked yarhuda are those with naturally much longer and heavier plume feathers. These hang over their shoulders like a cloak, draping down to their ankles while standing. Each of their flight feathers are tough and bristly, and heavy as chainmail. This makes extended flight impossible, but gives them exceptionally strong propeller muscles and feather tendons. Most long-cloaks lean into this, using the brief but powerful spins of their feathers to cause rapid updrafts. In a pinch, they can even batter aggressors with their long propeller feathers to defend themselves.

Alternate Heritage: Yarhuda growth shifts whether capable of flight or not. If your core race does not grant you a fly speed, replace the “Heavyweight Flier” and “Short-Distance Flier” racial traits with the following traits: 

  • Steel-Barbs:@Compendium[undertaking.abilities.PPM037YEDN1RJWOF]{Steel-Barbs}
  • Feather Armor:@Compendium[undertaking.abilities.K2QFFMREEEIYG061]{Feather Armor}
  • Lightning Vulnerability:Your hardened barbs are as conductive as steel. Unfortunately for you, all of your feathers discharge back through your body.
    You are vulnerable to lightning damage.
  • Reduced Move Speed:Your hardened feathers are thick, prickly, and awkward to move in.
    Your ground speed defined by your core race is reduced by 5 feet.
